claim: On a college basketball total where TheOver lists the hit rate of the model behind its pick, TheOver's side beats the number the sportsbooks close at.

scope.pick: TheOver's model pick that feeds the blend (theover_model_totals.backed and in_blend)
scope.game_match: exact; a game matched by similar names only is left out

bet.saved_run: the last run the app saved before the game started
bet.line_and_price: the board's line and its best price at that line in that run
bet.push: counts as a bet with zero return

close.source: closing_observations of the prediction evidence store
close.book: the same sportsbook as the bet
close.measure: points the total moved toward the pick between the bet and the close

windows.a_window_short_of_min_bets: is extended one night at a time until it has them
windows.if_the_closing_capture_has_not_run_on_ma: both windows move later by whole nights, as a new version of this file

reported_never_deciding: wins and losses with a 95% interval against the break-even rate
picks where the board's line differs from TheOver's own
on_pass: the owner reviews the result; funding a stake needs the research-store plan and the staking terms of 2026-11-08, a separate decision
on_failure: TheOver's college pick becomes record only (validation failed, or holdout failed after validation passed)
